title: Contact CounterCrave
description: Contact CounterCrave to report an error, suggest a correction or ask an editorial question.
summary: Report a factual error, outdated product detail or accessibility issue by emailing hello@countercrave.com.

sections.heading: What to include
paragraphs: Include the page URL, the statement you believe is incorrect, and a reliable source or explanation that can help the editorial team investigate.
The email address is a project default. Configure the mailbox before production launch.
bullets: Preferred reply address, when a reply is requested

faqs.question: What matters most when buying contact CounterCrave?
faqs.answer: Capacity, footprint, and cleanup. Confirm dimensions and accessories on the Amazon listing because bundles can change by seller.

faqs.question: Does CounterCrave show live prices?
faqs.answer: No. We link to Amazon so you can check current pricing, shipping, and stock with our disclosed Associates tags.

faqs.question: How often are pages updated?
faqs.answer: Priority commercial pages are refreshed when ASINs change, models retire, or a clearer fit appears for the same use case.

author: CounterCrave Editorial Team
